{{Top|leg}}
The '''New Republic Information Ministry''' was a branch of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] government that handles news and information.<ref name="bacta">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>

Prior to the [[Bacta War]], they tried to minimize the news of famed [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] members resigning their commissions.<ref name="bacta" />
